scope: Physical source lines including blanks in src/public/scripts/test/examples. Includes JS/TS/JSX/TSX, Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, C#, PHP (including artisan), Ruby (.rb/.ru and Rails bin/rails), Rust, Elixir, HTML/CSS, shell, Svelte/Vue/Astro/Razor. Excludes JSON/lockfiles, Dockerfiles, YAML, docs, dependencies and generated artifacts. Archived diagnostic reproducers under evidence/probes are excluded.
